message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下可靠來源：

| 平台 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 提供即時行情、新聞與分析 |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com/ | 專門報導貴金屬價格，更新頻率高 |
| Investing.com | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 提供圖表、技術分析與即時報價 |
| CNBC | https://www.cnbc.com/markets/commodities/ | 主要新聞與市場動態 |

您也可以直接在 Google 搜尋「Gold price today」或使用金融應用程式（如 Bloomberg、Yahoo Finance、TradingView）查看最新價格。祝您投資順利！
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources. We can also provide a typical price range. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites like Bloomberg, Kitco, etc.
